[SWS_CM_10320] Transport protocol for sending of a SOME/IP event message
⌈
The SOME/IP event message shall be transmitted using UDP if the threshold defined
by the multicastThreshold attribute of the SomeipProvidedEventGroup that
is aggregated by the ProvidedSomeipServiceInstance in the role eventGroup
in the Manifest has been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00134]).
The SOME/IP
event message shall be transmitted using the transport protocol defined by the
attribute SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment.fieldDeployment.notifier.
transportProtocol in the Manifest if this threshold has not been reached (see
[PRS_SOMEIPSD_00802]).
⌋
